Title: LSASS Memory Access via Suspicious GrantedAccess
Description: Detects processes accessing LSASS memory with suspicious access masks commonly used for credential dumping. Access masks 0x1010, 0x1410, and 0x143a are indicative of Mimikatz-style LSASS reading.
Author: EdrBrain
FalsePositives: Antivirus and EDR products accessing LSASS for credential protection

Title: Known Credential Dumping Tool Execution
Description: Detects execution of well-known credential dumping tools such as Mimikatz, Procdump, and LAPDump. These tools are almost never used legitimately in production environments.
Author: EdrBrain
FalsePositives: Security testing and red team exercises

Title: Browser Credential and Cookie Access
Description: Detects non-browser processes accessing browser profile directories containing saved credentials and cookies, a primary behavior of infostealer malware.
Author: EdrBrain
FalsePositives: Password managers and browser sync tools

Title: SAM Registry Hive Access
Description: Detects processes accessing the SAM registry hive, which contains local password hashes. This access is a prerequisite for SAM credential dumping attacks.
Author: EdrBrain

Title: Bulk Data Archive in Temp Directory
Description: Detects creation of compressed archives (ZIP, RAR, 7z) in temporary directories by non-standard processes, a common data staging behavior before exfiltration by infostealers.
Author: EdrBrain
FalsePositives: IT deployment tools and backup agents
